name: Daryl the Youngling
summary: At Farstrider Lodge, Daryl the Youngling tests travelers' marksmanship against Loch Modan's beasts. The young human hunter hopes to earn his place among veteran dwarven trackers.

sections.title: A Human Among Mountaineers
sections.body: Dwarven mountaineers, trackers, and seasoned outdoorsmen watch Loch Modan's wilderness from Farstrider Lodge. Daryl tests his hunting instincts against travelers there. He challenges them to hunt the tough wild boars and other beasts roaming the crags and lakeshore.

faq.answer: Daryl is a young human hunter at Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan. Among the lodge's seasoned dwarven marksmen, he challenges newcomers to test their hunting and tracking skills.
Daryl stays at Farstrider Lodge, on forested cliffs above Loch Modan's southeastern shores.
The lodge's dwarven marksmen and regulars have spent decades patrolling Khaz Modan's rugged backcountry. Daryl is young and untested beside them, still earning a lasting reputation as a hunter.

angles.text: Daryl's contests test the tracking, knowledge of beast behavior, and hunting skill that wandering hunters bring to Farstrider Lodge.
As a human, you can find a young person learning wilderness craft deep in dwarven territory. Practical camaraderie joins Ironforge and the human kingdoms.
